4. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended grouping markers by type (fine liners, brush pens, markers, highlighters), tip size (fine, medium, broad), and color family (primaries, secondaries, earth tones).

8. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised storing frequently used items front and center in easy-to-reach locations.

10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended labeling each container, drawer, and compartment, and creating a sign or chart for quick item location.
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized keeping the storage accessible and visible for easy retrieval.
12. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised regularly cleaning and maintaining the storage cart to prevent residue buildup.
